context: A retired diplomat and a teacher discuss a government scandal
purpose: Teach: 官房/省庁/起訴/告発/追及/朝刊/闘い/難民

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今朝の朝刊、ご覧になりましたか。官房長官の名前がまた一面に出ておりましたな。
lines.en: Did you see this morning's paper? The Chief Cabinet Secretary's name was on the front page again.
lines.style: Slow, gravelly elder register with formal politeness markers

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、読みました。関係省庁ぐるみの隠蔽だと書かれていて、本当に何とも言えない気分です。
lines.en: Yes, I read it. They wrote it was a cover-up involving multiple ministries — honestly, I don't know what to feel.
lines.style: Composed teacher tone, measured pace with thoughtful pauses

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 野党の追及もずいぶん鋭くなってきましたが、結局のところ、起訴まで持っていけるかどうかですよ。
lines.en: The opposition's questioning has gotten sharp, but in the end it comes down to whether they can bring an indictment.
lines.style: Sighing diplomat cadence, world-weary and analytical

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 内部告発をした方の勇気には頭が下がります。あれは一人の闘いだったと思います。
lines.en: I have nothing but respect for the whistleblower's courage. That must have been a lonely battle.
lines.style: Quiet admiration, gentle and reflective teacher voice

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: たしかに、組織を相手にするのは並大抵ではありません。私が現役の頃も似たようなことが繰り返されておりました。
lines.en: Indeed, taking on an institution is no small thing. Similar things happened back when I was still active.
lines.style: Reflective old-statesman voice with nostalgic weight

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 気になるのは、難民支援の予算まで削られそうだという話です。そちらの議論にこの問題が影を落とさなければいいのですが。
lines.en: What worries me is the talk of cutting the refugee support budget too. I hope this scandal doesn't cast a shadow over that debate.
lines.style: Concerned, civic-minded teacher with soft urgency

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。せめて、きちんと真相が明らかになるまで、私どもも声を上げ続けねばなりませんな。
lines.en: You're quite right. At the very least, we must keep raising our voices until the truth is properly brought to light.
lines.style: Resolute closing tone, dignified and firm elder cadence
